events.description: Fuzzy Dice plays a festive Saturday-after-Christmas party at The Orange Lantern. Dress in your holiday best.

events.title: Mid-Life Crisis at The Orange Lantern
events.location: The Orange Lantern, 15 E Firehouse Ln
events.description: Party band Mid-Life Crisis, fronted by Steve, Dani and Tommy, plays the first Saturday of the new year.

events.title: Meet at Barnes & Noble: Singles and Non-Singles
events.description: A relaxed bookstore meetup from the Bergen County Singles group, open to singles and non-singles alike.

events.title: Kyla Nicole Healey: Holiday Dinner & Show at the Meadowlands
events.location: Pink Restaurant, Meadowlands Racing & Entertainment, 1 Racetrack Drive
events.time_text: Buffet 5:00 PM - 7:45 PM; live racing 6:20 PM; performance 8:00 PM - 10:00 PM
events.description: A holiday dinner show at the racetrack: buffet and drink specials, live harness racing, then Kyla Nicole Healey singing jazz favorites, classics and originals.

places.name: The Roosevelt
places.hours_text: Closed Monday and Tuesday. Happy hour Wed-Sat 3-6 PM; late-night happy hour Thu-Sat 10 PM-midnight; Lucy's Parlor speakeasy Thu-Sun 3 PM-1 AM
places.description: A Roaring Twenties saloon and dining room with a hidden speakeasy. Its calendar names the DJ or live act for every entertainment night; November's DJs are DJ Anthony Pags, DJ Ralph Tunis and DJ G Rock, mostly on Saturdays.

places.name: Williams Center
places.description: Rutherford's ticketed party and concert room. The Black Box hosts touring themed dance parties (2000s hip-hop and R&B, emo night, Santa Rave, I Love R&B) alongside tribute bands; the full calendar runs months ahead.

places.name: CZEN Restaurant Englewood
places.hours_text: Fridays 12 PM - midnight; Saturday party nights until 1 AM
places.description: Caribbean-Asian fusion restaurant near bergenPAC with a DJ most nights: DJ Lefty on Un-Wine Wednesdays, karaoke and games with Dre & DJ Fish on Thursdays, a live DJ Fridays 8 PM to midnight, Caribbean Second Saturdays with Kevin Crown and DJ Dee One, and DJ Kim U at Sunday brunch.

places.name: The Craftsman
places.hours_text: Mon-Wed 4 PM-midnight; Thu 4 PM-1 AM; Fri 4 PM-2 AM; Sat 11 AM-2 AM; Sun 11 AM-midnight
places.description: 'Come for dinner, stay for the party': local DJs every Thursday, Friday and Saturday, Ladies' Night on Thursdays, Taco & Tequila Tuesdays, plus drag brunches and an open-bar New Year's Eve. Phone 201-773-8985.

places.name: Life After Restaurant & Lounge
places.hours_text: Happy hour drinks all night Wednesday and Thursday; late-night happy hour 11 PM - 1 AM Friday and Saturday
places.description: An R&B-leaning restaurant and lounge on the Edgewater waterfront: live band Fridays that turn into DJ sets until 1 AM (DJ APlus, DJ Rockon), 90s 'Rewind' nights, R&B and hip-hop bingo on after-work Wednesdays and a 'Roc Da Mic' sing-along Sunday brunch.

places.name: Shawn's Crazy Saloon
places.description: A big live-music saloon with ticketed shows most weekends: Latin dance nights and rock en espanol, tribute bands and country, usually 9 PM to 1:30 AM with the kitchen open late. 21+ after 9 PM on party nights.

places.name: Dominick's Restaurant & Bar
places.price_text: No cover; $25 per person minimum on entertainment nights
places.hours_text: Closed Monday; Tue-Thu 11:30 AM-10 PM; Fri-Sat 11:30 AM-11 PM (bar to 1 AM); Sun 11:30 AM-9 PM
places.description: Old-school Italian restaurant with live entertainment every Friday and Saturday night, a Disco Night with DJ Frankie D about twice a month and karaoke every Thursday 7 to 11 PM. A dinner-then-dancing spot for the 40-and-up crowd. Phone 201-939-1128.

places.name: Havana Dance Center
places.description: A ballroom and Latin studio whose socials are the easiest way to go out dancing without a club: a Saturday Night Ballroom & Latin Social, a Friday salsa and bachata Latin Social and a Thursday daytime social. Dates are posted one at a time; call 201-639-4169.

places.name: City Lounge
places.description: Lounge that has hosted the free Tokes N Jokes stand-up open mic every Thursday at 9 PM for almost ten years (18+).

places.name: Cigarro Bar & Lounge
places.description: Downtown Hackensack cigar bar and lounge with specialty drinks and food. It hosts a 35+ singles night on Dec 17 and is part of the Main Street bar scene; parking in the Atlantic Street garage across the way.

places.name: Midland Brew House
places.hours_text: Listed specials run 7 PM - 1 AM; New Year's Eve listed 11 AM - 2 AM
places.description: Late-night bar and grill whose site lists a Wednesday Girls Night Out, Tacos & Trivia and football-night specials. The website names no DJs; its Friday and Saturday DJ nights were seen only in Instagram search snippets and are unconfirmed.

places.name: Crazy Pocha
places.hours_text: Open seven days until 2 AM (per an April 2026 opening report)
places.description: A Korean pocha-style bar that opened in spring 2026: late-night Korean food and drinks with K-pop on, priced to be affordable.

places.name: Soosanghan Pocha
places.description: Korean pocha with pojangmacha-style seating, a bar and private karaoke rooms, listed as open until 2:30 AM. Details come from a directory listing, not the venue itself; call 201-482-4568 to confirm hours and book a room.

places.name: Lefkes at The Modern
places.hours_text: Sun-Tue 12 PM-10 PM; Wed-Thu 12 PM-11 PM; Fri-Sat 12 PM-1 AM
places.description: The upscale Greek restaurant that took over the former Ventanas space at The Modern, with a raw bar, grilled octopus, branzino and steaks, open until 1 AM on weekends. DJ and supper-club nights have been reported as planned but no schedule was found.

held.title: Thanksgiving Eve Party with DJ Chaos at The Craftsman
held.description: Unconfirmed: from a search snippet of the venue's Instagram noted by our source scout on Nov 12; the post could not be reopened and the party is not on The Craftsman's website. Call 201-773-8985 to confirm before recommending.
